summary: AB test harness traffic billed as production after postback routing mismatch
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports a large unexpected charge on the 2026-02-28 invoice where ~1.5M inference tokens from an internal AB test harness were billed at production rates. AtlasHealth runs parallel A/B experiments and a simulator service that should be tagged and billed as test/sandbox. They claim the simulator traffic was routed to production billing after a configuration change to their AB test keys on 2026-02-27.

Impact:
- Invoice 2026-02-28 shows a $24,123.72 line item for hosted-generation tokens tied to org_id 0a3f-AtlasHealth that the customer asserts were simulation runs.
- Customer requests a full explanation and provisional credit while we investigate.

Environment:
- Org ID: 0a3f-AtlasHealth
- API keys affected: ah-abtest-xx, ah-prod-1
- Region: us-east (hosted)
- Models: redwood/longchat-3b (variant v2-quant)

Steps to reproduce (reported by customer):
1) Trigger AB test job via internal harness with key ah-abtest-xx between 2026-02-27T18:00:00Z and 2026-02-28T02:00:00Z.
2) Observe large token counts in their scheduler logs.
3) Check invoice and see tokens billed at standard hosted unit rate.

Expected behavior:
- Traffic from ah-abtest-xx should be marked as sandbox/test and billed at test/sandbox rate (or zero if flagged). Postback processor should include origin=test in usage postbacks.

Actual behavior:
- Postbacks from the AB harness were accepted by postback-processor and recorded as production usage. The origin field is missing in several postback entries.

Relevant logs/attachments:
- Customer attached job id list: [job-8281, job-8282, job-8283]
- Invoice snippet attached by customer (invoice_2026-02-28_page1.pdf)
- Customer-provided curl of postback payload (included in attachments).
comments: 2026-03-12 Priya Menon (Support): Acknowledged receipt from customer; opened ticket and requested exact job IDs and sample postback payloads. SLA P1 acknowledged, aiming for provisional credit within 24 hours.

2026-03-12 AtlasHealth AI (Customer - Jordan Lee): Provided job ids and postback JSONs. Notes: 'ah-abtest-xx' has been used for weeks and never billed before; changed a routing flag in our AB service on 2026-02-27 at 17:58:21Z — we suspect that key got mapped to prod erroneously.
2026-03-12 Liam O'Connor (Support): Confirmed we've received attachments and escalated to SRE + Billing for investigation. Tagging INT-4412 for infra investigation into postback routing rules.

2026-03-13 Riley Chen (SRE): Found postback ingestion entries where origin metadata was omitted between 2026-02-27T17:55Z and 2026-02-28T03:10Z for multiple orgs. Query attached: SELECT count(*) FROM postbacks WHERE origin IS NULL AND received_at BETWEEN '2026-02-27T17:50:00Z' AND '2026-02-28T03:15:00Z' AND org_id='0a3f-AtlasHealth'; result: 1,482,936 rows. Hypothesis: a recent deployment to postback-processor dropped defaulting logic when origin header missing.

2026-03-13 Tamara Ortiz (Billing): Cross-referenced invoice lines; isolated tokens to line item B-2026-02-28-03; awaiting SRE mapping of postback ids to invoice ledger ids before proposing credit amount.
investigation_notes: SRE log excerpt: postback-processor v3.12.0 deployed 2026-02-27T17:45Z included change 'do-not-assume-origin' which removed fallback 'origin=test' when header absent. This coincides with customer traffic window.

Mapping job_ids -> usage rows: jobs job-8281..job-8283 map to postback batch ids pb-9a2..pb-9a4. Ledger entries reference pb-9a2..pb-9a4 on invoice line B-2026-02-28-03. Re-run SQL to extract token_count per pb id: returned totals matching approx 1.52M tokens billed.

Customer keys: ah-abtest-xx previously sent origin=test header via their harness; our ingestion normally defaults missing origin to 'test' for keys on 'abtest' prefix via config map 'origin-key-patterns'. That config map was unintentionally overwritten in the 2026-02-27 deploy, removing the 'abtest' pattern.
resolution: Provisional credit of $24,123.72 applied to AtlasHealth AI account (credit id CR-2026-214589) against invoice 2026-02-28. Root cause: postback-processor deployment removed default origin fallback for keys matching 'abtest' pattern, causing simulator traffic to be recorded as production. Fixes: rolled back v3.12.0 patch at 2026-03-13T04:12Z to restore origin defaulting; applied config guard to prevent accidental overwrite of 'origin-key-patterns'; added a canary test that sends postback without origin header and asserts correct fallback. Related infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2891. Follow-ups: INT-4412 created to add unit and integration tests; update runbook page 'Postback Origin Tagging Runbook' to include post-deploy verification steps. Customer confirmed provisional credit acceptance and requested closure after final audit on 2026-03-20.
follow_up_actions: INT-4412 - Add unit tests for origin fallback behavior and prevent configmap overwrite
PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2891 - adds canary test and config guard
Finance - reconcile credit CR-2026-214589 against invoice 2026-02-28 and confirm ledger adjustments
